subject: Mutual Action Plan & pricing — SignalWave MAP draft and commit request
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Greene <alyssa@signalwave.com>, Ben Torres <ben.torres@signalwave.com>
Cc: procurement@signalwave.com
Date: Tue, 04 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual Action Plan & pricing — SignalWave MAP draft and commit request

Hi Alyssa / Ben —

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation and helpful visibility into your Q4 priorities. As promised, attached is a draft Mutual Action Plan (SignalWave-MAP-draft-v2.xlsx) that captures the milestones we discussed, owners, and a recommended target close date. High level:

- Target close: 2026-09-15 (to align with your Q4 rollout)
- Proposed commitments: 12 months, $50k committed annual spend (we've outlined tiered pricing in the attached PDF)
- Key dependencies: SOC 2 evidence, VPC peering confirmation, SSO/SCIM setup, and procurement PO timing

Action items in the MAP are mapped to folks on both sides. I highlighted three exec-level asks that we need to surface for pricing/commit approval: a) 15% net discount on list for a 12mo commit (or b) 10% + $10k onboarding credit for a 6mo pilot), b) $10k onboarding credit if procurement executes within 30 days, and c) a limited performance credit if latency breach occurs in first 60 days.

Would you and Ben review the MAP and confirm owners + any missing dependencies? If you're comfortable, I'll escalate the pricing ask to my manager for exec review and a formal proposal.

Attachments: SignalWave-MAP-draft-v2.xlsx (MAP), SW-pricing-summary.pdf (pricing tiers & committed discounts)

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0199

From: Alyssa Greene <alyssa@signalwave.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 04 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan & pricing — SignalWave MAP draft and commit request

Thanks Karthik —

Nice write-up and the MAP looks like a solid starting point. A few quick clarifications from our side:

- SOC 2: We do need to review evidence; legal will take a look next week.
- VPC peering: Our infra team needs to validate CIDR ranges; that's a 3-5 day dependency.
- SSO/SCIM: We can commit to an engineering resource but will need details on the SAML metadata and provisioning schedule.

On pricing: the 15% for 12 months is attractive, but procurement will push for a commit level closer to $75k to approve that net. If we do a 6mo pilot, the onboarding credit helps but we need better clarity on T&Cs for the performance credit.

I'll sync with Ben and procurement and come back with confirmed owners by EOD Friday (Aug 7). Please do escalate the pricing ask — if you can include an example ELA term and the performance credit language, that will speed internal approval.

Regards,
Alyssa Greene
VP Product, SignalWave
alyssa@signalwave.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 05 Aug 2026 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Mutual Action Plan & pricing — SignalWave MAP draft and commit request

Team — forwarding the customer response below. SignalWave is interested but procurement is pushing for a higher commit to get 15% off. They signaled $50k baseline; procurement may push to $75k. They also asked for explicit ELA terms around a performance credit for latency breaches and evidence for SOC 2.

Quick summary:
- Account: SignalWave (Alyssa Greene / Ben Torres)
- Target close: 2026-09-15 (customer asks to keep this timeline)
- Recommended Redwood proposal: 12mo commitment, $50k committed ARR, 15% discount + $10k onboarding credit if PO in 30 days, and a capped performance credit (max 10% of first invoice) tied to SLO miss in first 60 days.

Asks:
1) Marissa — can we get exec approval to offer 15% off with $50k commit OR 12% off with $40k commit? Which is preferable from a territory quota perspective?
2) Laura — can you prepare an ELA draft with the performance-credit language and standard SOC 2 evidence bundle link for procurement?
3) Vivek — any constraints from pricing/finance on credits being applied on invoice vs. as a service credit?

Attachments: SignalWave-MAP-draft-v2.xlsx, SW-pricing-summary.pdf

Thanks — will keep the thread updated once I hear back from the customer on owners.

Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 05 Aug 2026 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Mutual Action Plan & pricing — SignalWave MAP draft and commit request

Thanks for the summary, Karthik. Quick guidance:

- Approve 15% net discount only if the customer signs a 12-month commitment at >= $50k ARR and a purchase order is received within 30 days. If they push to $75k, great — prioritize the higher commit but don't let that stall the close.
- Approve $10k onboarding credit contingent on PO in 30 days (apply as invoice credit).
- Approve a capped performance credit (max 10% of month 1 invoice) subject to SLO definition and validation by our SRE team. Laura — please include a validation/incident review clause in the ELA.

Karthik: push back on procurement and ask if they'd accept the 12mo/$50k + credit; mention we can flex to $75k for expanded discounts but we need procurement to sign quickly to get the onboarding credit.

I'll flag this to revenue ops if needed, but this looks within standard deal flex. Vivek — if there are any billing constraints, flag here.

-Marissa
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Greene <alyssa@signalwave.com>, Ben Torres <ben.torres@signalwave.com>
Cc: procurement@signalwave.com, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Aug 2026 16:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan & pricing — SignalWave MAP draft and commit request

Alyssa / Ben — thanks for the quick review and helpful context. Following internal review, we can make the following commercial offer to help meet your Q4 timing:

1) Pricing & commit options (pick one):
   - Option A (recommended): 12-month commitment, $50,000 ARR committed spend -> 15% net discount + $10,000 onboarding credit applied to first invoice (PO required within 30 days).
   - Option B (pilot): 6-month pilot, $25,000 committed spend -> 10% net discount + $10,000 onboarding credit (no performance credit).

2) Performance credit: a capped service credit (max 10% of month 1 invoice) applicable only if verified SLO breaches occur in the first 60 days; credits applied as invoice credits after incident validation per ELA.

3) Next steps / MAP updates:
   - Can you confirm owners for SOC 2 review (legal), VPC CIDR validation (infrastructure), and SAML metadata (identity)? We've updated the MAP (attached) with these dependencies and target dates.
   - If you prefer Option A, reply with intent and we'll issue a formal ELA + commercial SOW for signature.

Attachments: SignalWave-MAP-draft-v2.xlsx (updated with pricing options), SW-pricing-summary.pdf

I'll follow up with a calendar invite to review the ELA drafts if you'd like. Appreciate the partnership — happy to jump on a quick call to resolve any procurement questions.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0199
